text:
NSW I4D15 
 Safety curtains 
[2019: NSW H101.10] 
A safety curtain required by NSW I4D8 must— 
be made of non-combustible material; and 
(a)
be so fitted that, when it is closed, it forms an efficient smoke seal between the stage and the auditorium; and 
(b)
be capable of withstanding a pressure differential of 0.5 kPa over its entire surface area; and 
(c)
be run on steel guides located on each side of the proscenium opening; and 
(d)
remain engaged in its guides if the guides, together with their fittings and attachments and that part of the curtain 
(e)
engaged in the guides, are subjected to a pressure differential of 1 kPa; and 
be of sufficiently robust construction to withstand damage by scenery, stage properties and falling debris; and 
(f)
be capable of closing the proscenium opening within 30 seconds, either by gravity slide or by motor assisted 
(g)
mechanisms; and 
have manual controls, located on each side of the stage, for the closing of the curtains; and 
(h)
have a notice displayed adjacent to the operating controls, in clear and legible letters and symbols of adequate 
(i)
size, indicating its use and operation; and 
when operated, actuate a distinctive warning alarm audible to persons on the stage and must not be reliant for 
(j)
its operation solely on the primary electricity supply; and 
have the words “Safety Curtain” exhibited on the curtain in clear and legible letters of adequate size to enable 
(k)
them to be read from all parts of the auditorium.
